o.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian اهل حال (ahl-i hāl).
From Venetan barbièr (Italian barbiere). Probably via Ottoman Turkish بربر (berber) (Turkish berber).
From Middle Mongol ᠬᠠᠷᠠᠭᠤᠯ (qaraɣul). Cognate with Turkish karakol, Uzbek qorovul, Persian قراول (qarâvol).
Borrowed from Persian سفربر (safarbar, “who undertakes a journey, ready to travel”).
